transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. Let's get started. We've got the talent-show finale going live this Saturday at 9:00 PM Eastern, and we need to finalize the voting package tonight so we can get through the pre-air lock meeting with standards, platform production, rights, and data protection. The current draft has SMS and online portal voting open to our broadcast audience. Before I make my binding decision on the final package, I want to hear from each of you — what issues, risks, or gaps are you seeing with the current draft? Let's go around the room.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical gap. The current draft voting rules were circulated before I issued the network's latest standards memo. That memo establishes three binding requirements that are NOT reflected in the current draft: first, voters must be at least 13 years old; second, each voter may cast exactly one vote per verified account; and third, voting must close at 9:50 PM Eastern. The draft as it stands doesn't incorporate any of these constraints, and all three need to be built into the final package before we can clear it at the pre-air lock meeting.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical platform issue. I completed the platform certification test this morning, and the SMS integration failed certification — it is not approved for use. The web portal passed certification, but the approved portal requires account verification before a vote is accepted. This means SMS voting cannot be part of the final package as currently drafted, and any voting flow must go through the verified web portal only.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rights issue. I obtained the finalist label's written approval today, and it confirms that the voting interface may display finalist names and approved headshots, but it may NOT use any finalist performance audio or video. The current draft interface still contains performance clips. Those clips must be removed before the final package can be cleared at the pre-air lock meeting, or we will not have the rights clearance we need.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical data protection issue. I completed the privacy review with the voting vendor this week, and it establishes two binding requirements that are NOT reflected in the current draft: first, participation must be limited to viewers physically located in the United States and Canada — the draft still describes worldwide participation; second, voter identifiers must be deleted within 30 days — the draft currently has no deletion step at all. Both of these must be incorporated into the final package before it can be cleared at the pre-air lock meeting.
transcript.speaker: A5
